title: Mars' Surface Radiation Environment Measured with the Mars Science Laboratory's Curiosity Rover
description: First real measurements of the radiation environment on the surface of Mars inside Gale Crater. Demonstrates an average surface dose equivalent rate of 0.64 ± 0.12 mSv/day.

title: Measurements of Energetic Particle Radiation in Transit to Mars on the Mars Science Laboratory
description: Crucial dosimetry data collected during 253 days of deep space interplanetary cruise from Earth to Mars, measuring an average dose equivalent rate of 1.84 ± 0.30 mSv/day.

title: Mars Science Laboratory RAD Calibrated Data Records (RDR V1.0)
description: Calibrated energetic particle detector counts, LET spectra, and dosimetric channels archived on the Planetary Data System (PDS) Planetary Plasma Interactions Node.
